title: Two-drug antiretroviral therapy with doravirine/dolutegravir - a prospective cohort study
summary:
Combinations of 2 drugs (2-DR) are playing an increasingly important role in everyday treatment of HIV infection. However, the two approved 2-DR fixed-dose combinations (FDC) of lamivudine (3TC) or rilpivirine (RPV) each with dolutegravir (DTG) may not be feasible in specific situations due to HIV resistance or drug-drug interactions. Doravirine (DOR) is another combination partner for DTG with a theoretically very favorable efficacy, safety, and interaction profile, so the 2-DR DOR/DTG is increasingly being used. However, this specific combination has not been thoroughly studied.
Therefore, in order to improve the evidence base, the use of the 2-DR DOR/DTG in everyday HIV treatment will be documented and described in a structured way within the framework of an observational study using already existing data. Participation in this observational study is offered to people living with HIV infection at the Outpatient Clinic for Infectious Diseases at LMU Klinikum Innenstadt as well as other outpatient clinics and specialized practices in German-speaking countries, if their therapy has been switched to (exclusively) DOR/DTG.
Primarily the following will be described 
- the clinical situation in which DOR/DTG is prescribed
- the efficacy of DOR/DTG with regard to health status and laboratory values
Further objectives are the description of
- the frequency and causes of switching to DOR/DTG in situations outside of the approval label
- the duration of therapy with DOR/DTG and reasons for a further switch to other drugs

interventions.name: People living with HIV infection whose therapy was switched to a combination of doravirine/dolutegravir only (DoDo). Documentation of the treatment course from approx. 1 year before switching to DoDo until up to 5 years after the switch within a prospective solely observational cohort study.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Persons being cared for in clinics and private practices in German-speaking areas
• Age >18 years
• documented HIV-1-infection
• documented previous treatment with antiretroviral therapy (ART)
• switch of ART to exclusively DOR/DTG
• written informed consent after discussion of patient information
Exclusion criteria:
• Inability to consent
• switch of ART to DOR/DTG in a clinic/practice not participating in the study
• antiretroviral therapy including other substances except DOR/DTG
